description: Put a single run's stops in the best visiting order ("order my errands"). Provide `start` {lat, lon} and `stops` (1-100 entries of {location, label?, service_s?}); optionally an `end` destination or `round_trip`: true to return to the start. Costing "auto" = car, "truck" = lorry (pass `truck` as in `route` for a truck-legal order). Returns the stops in visit order with arrival offsets in seconds, plus total duration and distance.

CostingKind.description:
Costing models exposed by the MCP tools (a deliberate subset of the
Valhalla costing list), serialised in snake_case exactly as Valhalla
names them.

oneOf.description:
Truck costing; honours dimensional limits and, when a `truck`
profile is supplied, ADR dangerous-goods restrictions.
Bicycle costing; tune it with a `bicycle` options object.

Pedestrian (walking) costing; tune it with a `pedestrian` options
object (lit streets, wheelchair/blind, hiking difficulty).

Motor scooter (moped) costing: like auto but prefers lower-speed
roads and may use ways closed to larger motor vehicles.

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

OrderStopSpec.description: One errand stop of an `order_stops` request.

label.description:
Human-readable label echoed back in the ordered plan
(e.g. "chemist" or "site B").

service_s.description: On-site time in seconds (waiting, loading, shopping).

TruckSpec.description:
Truck profile for routing: physical dimensions plus the ADR
dangerous-goods declaration. Omitted dimensions default to the EU
maximum authorised dimensions of Council Directive 96/53/EC (4.0 m
height, 2.55 m width, 16.5 m length, 40 t gross weight).

gross_weight_t.description: Gross combination weight in metric tonnes.

hazmat.description:
Whether the vehicle carries dangerous goods (ADR). Defaults to
false.

tunnel_code.description:
ADR 8.6.4 tunnel restriction code of the load, e.g. "B", "C5000D",
"B/D", or "(—)"/"none" for explicitly unrestricted. Leave unset if
unknown: a hazmat load without a code is conservatively treated as
code B (allowed only through category-A tunnels).

end.description:
Optional fixed final destination. Mutually exclusive with
`round_trip`; omitted (and not a round trip), the run ends at
whichever stop the solver visits last.

round_trip.description: Return to `start` after the last stop (default false).

stops.description: The stops to put in the best visiting order (1–100).

truck.description:
Truck profile (dimensions + ADR declaration); requires costing
"truck". The travel-time matrix then respects dimensional and
dangerous-goods restrictions.

name: order_stops

LatLon.description: A WGS84 coordinate in decimal degrees: a {lat, lon} object (preferred), or a GeoJSON [lon, lat] array with LONGITUDE FIRST, the same order as every polygon field on this server.

OrderedStop.description: One stop of an ordered errand plan.

arrival_s.description: Arrival time as an offset from departure, in seconds.

label.description: The request's label for this stop, when one was given.

stop_index.description: The stop's 0-based index in the request's `stops` array.

distance_m.description: Total travel distance in metres, when reported.

ordered.description: The stops in optimal visiting order.

unassigned_stop_indexes.description:
0-based indexes of stops the solver could not fit (empty in the
normal, unconstrained case).
